div.div: مَحْسَرٌ (tropical:) The internal, or intrinsic, state or quality, (S, A, K,) of a person; (S, A;) as also ↓ مَحْسِرٌ : (K:) and the latter, [or both,] the nature, or natural disposition. (K, TA.) You say, فُلَانٌ كَرِيمُ المَحْسَرِ (tropical:) Such a one is generous, or noble, in respect of his internal, or intrinsic, state or quality: (S, A:) or ↓ المَحْسِرِ , meaning as above: or in respect of his nature, or natural disposition: or face, or countenance. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
